issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other 23,926.00 (General Fund), 62% of governmental receipts 38,638.00
issues.issue: An unexplained 'Other' line makes up most of the year's governmental receipts. Per the extractor rules that is a question for a person (it could be loan proceeds, a grant, etc.), but decision_needed[] is absent.
The sewer receipts are assumed to be user fees, but the page prints only 'Other' with no breakdown. Review note is present.
User rule 2026-10-26/28: capital outlay lines are labelled 'Capital Outlay: <function>' with the printed text in printed_label. Not applied here; the function isn't printed (General Fund).
Equity lines carry no category field (list items should have category)
Memo county treasurer balances are printed outside the line 24/28 totals. They are not recorded or mentioned in notes; probably correctly excluded, but the exclusion isn't documented.
